data.text:
Mumbai Police issues traffic advisory ahead of Lionel Messi event at Wankhede Stadium on December 14 , urging commuters to plan travel and expect heavy congestion in surrounding areas.

Road diversions and parking restrictions will be implemented near Colaba, Marine Drive, and adjoining streets to manage the large crowd efficiently.

Commuters are advised to use public transport, avoid private vehicles where possible, and follow police instructions for a smooth, safe experience during the Goat India Tour 2025 event.

By🖋️: Asif Rizvi
